title: Carrier, mass and support facts for integer multiplicity currents in ℝ^P
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and write 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) for GeometricCurrentOn univ n. (1) Let Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be represented by an integer multiplicity triple R = (M, θ, ξ) in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n, R.Represents Y), and let μ_R := θ·Hⁿ⌞M (R.measure, Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then Hⁿ(M ∖ spt Y) = 0, the total mass satisfies M(Y) = μ_R(ℝ^P) (Y.mass = R.measure univ), and if spt Y is compact then μ_R(ℝ^P) < ∞. (2) For all Y₁, Y₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P): spt Y₁ is closed, and spt(Y₁ − Y₂) ⊆ spt Y₁ ∪ spt Y₂, where Y₁ − Y₂ is the pointwise difference of currents.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.Represents Y → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ Y.support) = 0 ∧ Y.mass = R.measure univ ∧ (IsCompact Y.support → R.measure univ ≠ ∞)) ∧ ∀ Y₁ Y₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsClosed Y₁.support ∧ (Y₁ - Y₂).support ⊆ Y₁.support ∪ Y₂.support
